pages.text: The $(l)Seven Sins$() is an alchemical accessory, worn with 80 luck, made at the $(l)primordial altar$() from the seven sigils.$(br2)$(l)Recipe$(): carried by the Sin Lords. In each world the two lords (Pride aside) who carry no primordial charm recipe carry one each: the Seven Sins and the World Core.$(br2)It grants all seven sin powers (as a weapon forged with the lords' materials does), each strengthened.

$(li)Pride: +100% vs. targets with less health share$(li)Greed: Looting +2, 10% life steal$(li)Sloth: Slowness III, Mining Fatigue III for 4s$(li)Envy: 30% to steal a buff$(li)Wrath: +15% per 10% health missing$(li)Gluttony: kills heal 20%$(li)Lust: executes non-bosses under 20%$(li)Damage from Sin Lords and their kin -30%
